summary: Browse mods in Lichii, get back the FPS lost in build 366, and try new frame generation options.
summary_zh_CN: 在 Lichii 内浏览模组，恢复第 366 版损失的帧率，并试用新的插帧选项。

changes.title: Mod Store
changes.body: Open Tools → Mod Store or Add-Ons → Browse Mods. Find GameBanana mods and over 11,000 Switch 1 listings for 60 FPS and ultrawide patches and cheats. Lichii checks patch build IDs against your game.
changes.body_zh_CN: 从「工具 → Mod 商店」或「附加项 → 浏览模组」进入。可浏览 GameBanana 模组，以及超过 11,000 个 Switch 1 条目，包括 60 FPS 补丁、超宽屏补丁和金手指。Lichii 会核对补丁的构建 ID 是否与游戏匹配。

changes.title: FPS recovery after build 366
changes.title_zh_CN: 恢复第 366 版损失的帧率
changes.body: Build 366's third GPU thread cut FPS by about 70% in one Ocarina of Time test. It's back off by default. To try the reworked version, go to Graphics → Advanced → Render thread (experimental).
changes.body_zh_CN: 在一次《时之笛》测试中，第 366 版的第三个 GPU 线程使帧率下降了约 70%。此功能已恢复为默认关闭。要试用改进后的版本，可前往「图形 → 高级 → 渲染线程（实验性）」。

changes.title: FlyHigh on Windows
changes.body: FlyHigh is an optional neural frame generator for Vulkan games in SDR on x86-64 Windows. Choose it in the frame generation menu and accept the model license to download it.
changes.body_zh_CN: FlyHigh 是可选的神经网络插帧功能，适用于 x86-64 Windows 上以 SDR 运行的 Vulkan 游戏。在插帧菜单中选中它，接受模型许可协议后即可下载。

changes.title: Better Lichii Optical Flow
changes.title_zh_CN: 改进 Lichii 光流插帧
changes.body: Optical Flow tracks faster camera pans and small sprite movements more accurately. Generated frames show less ghosting around moving outlines.
changes.body_zh_CN: 光流插帧能更准确地跟踪快速平移的镜头和精灵图的细微移动，减少生成帧中运动物体边缘的重影。

changes.title: Wonder, Pokopia, and Ori
changes.body: Mario Wonder's Switch 2 Edition gets a built-in 60 FPS patch. Pokopia 2.0.1 boots again, and Ori and the Will of the Wisps can replace Spirit Trial ghosts without freezing on Windows.
changes.body_zh_CN: 《超级马力欧兄弟 惊奇》Switch 2 版新增内置 60 FPS 补丁。Pokopia 2.0.1 恢复正常启动，《奥日与鬼火意志》在 Windows 上替换精灵试炼的幽灵记录时不再卡死。

changes.title: Game graphics fixes
changes.body: Fixes broken battle sprites in Final Fantasy Resonance on AMD, missing gloom in Hyrule Warriors: Age of Imprisonment, and black or flickering trims in Ocarina of Time.
changes.body_zh_CN: 修复 Final Fantasy Resonance 在 AMD 显卡上的战斗精灵图异常，修复《塞尔达无双 封印战记》的瘴气缺失，以及《时之笛》中装饰边缘发黑或闪烁的问题。

changes.title: Less texture spill on low-VRAM GPUs
changes.title_zh_CN: 减少低显存显卡的纹理溢出
changes.body: Lichii decodes large ASTC texture arrays in smaller batches so their temporary images don't spill into system RAM.
changes.body_zh_CN: Lichii 将大型 ASTC 纹理数组拆成较小的批次解码，避免临时图像占用系统内存。

changes.title: Better shader precompilation
changes.body: Precompile All Shaders remembers your choice for that game. Lichii reuses pipelines built earlier in the same session and shows how many shader builds remain.
changes.body_zh_CN: 「预编译所有着色器」会记住该游戏的预编译设置。Lichii 会复用本次会话中已构建的管线，并显示仍需构建的着色器数量。

summary: A third GPU thread, better Switch 2 Edition support, and game fixes.
summary_zh_CN: 新增第三个 GPU 线程，改进 Switch 2 版支持并修复多项游戏问题。

changes.title: A third GPU thread
changes.body: Eligible Switch 2 Vulkan draws use a third recording thread.
changes.body_zh_CN: 符合条件的 Switch 2 Vulkan 绘制命令可由第三个线程录制。

changes.title: Ocarina of Time above 60 FPS
changes.title_zh_CN: 《时之笛》超过 60 FPS 时的修复
changes.body: FPS Unlock fixes Epona's fence jump, the day/night clock and the Deku Tree webs. The game no longer freezes after closing the R1 menu.
changes.body_zh_CN: 解锁帧率的补丁修复了 Epona 跳栅栏、昼夜计时和德库树内的蛛网问题。关闭 R1 菜单后，游戏也不再卡死。

changes.title: Switch 2 games in HOME and better Edition support
changes.title_zh_CN: 从 HOME 启动游戏并改进 Switch 2 版支持
changes.body: Launch games from HOME without installing them. Lichii better detects and launches Switch 2 Editions, applies matching upgrade packs, and keeps update information in NUPs.
changes.body_zh_CN: 可直接从 HOME 菜单启动游戏，无需安装。Lichii 改进了 Nintendo Switch 2 Edition 的识别和启动，能应用匹配的升级包，并保留 NUP 中的更新信息。

changes.title: Precompile All Shaders
changes.body: Turn it on for individual games in their right-click menu. Precompilation can now find compute shaders in asset packs such as Kirby Air Riders' packs.
changes.body_zh_CN: 可在单款游戏的右键菜单中启用。预编译现在也能找到《卡比的驭天飞行者》等游戏资源包中的计算着色器。

changes.title: Xenoblade DE and Yoshi fixes
changes.title_zh_CN: 《异度神剑 终极版》和耀西游戏的修复
changes.body: Fixes Xenoblade DE's title-screen textures and docked/handheld crash. Yoshi no longer crashes when Vulkan rejects a texture-buffer view.
changes.body_zh_CN: 修复《异度神剑 终极版》的标题画面纹理，以及切换主机和掌机模式时的崩溃。Vulkan 拒绝纹理缓冲区视图时，耀西游戏也不再崩溃。

changes.title: Multiplayer room connections
changes.body: The room proxy keeps the right player address and port and drops packets left over from earlier connections.
changes.body_zh_CN: 房间代理会保留正确的玩家地址和端口，并丢弃先前连接遗留的数据包。

changes.title: What's New in Lichii
changes.body: See the highlights after an update or reopen them anytime from Help, even offline.
changes.body_zh_CN: 更新后可查看版本亮点，也可以随时通过「帮助」菜单重新打开，离线也能查看。

summary: Fewer shader stalls, fixes for Cyberpunk 2077 and Ocarina of Time, and Switch 2 Pro Controller support.
summary_zh_CN: 减少着色器编译卡顿，修复《赛博朋克 2077》和《时之笛》的问题，并支持 Nintendo Switch 2 Pro 手柄。

changes.title: Fewer shader stalls
changes.body: Async shaders now use the Bounded setting by default, with an 8 ms wait. If you chose a setting yourself, Lichii keeps it.
changes.body_zh_CN: 异步着色器编译现在默认使用「限时等待」，等待上限为 8 毫秒。Lichii 会保留你手动选择的设置。

changes.title: Cyberpunk 2077
changes.body: Lichii can now translate the 64 shaders that previously failed in this game.
changes.body_zh_CN: Lichii 现在可以正确转换这款游戏中此前转换失败的 64 个着色器。

changes.title: Ocarina of Time
changes.body: Choose 2×, 4×, or instant text with the new add-ons. Unlocked frame rates are also presented more smoothly.
changes.body_zh_CN: 新增的附加项可让文字以 2 倍速、4 倍速或瞬间显示。解锁帧率后，画面也更流畅。

changes.title: Switch 2 Pro Controller
changes.body: Connect over USB on Windows or Linux, or over Bluetooth in the Windows desktop app.
changes.body_zh_CN: Windows 和 Linux 支持通过 USB 连接，Windows 桌面版还支持蓝牙连接。

changes.title: Star Fox
changes.body: The floor in the Venom mission renders again.
changes.body_zh_CN: 修复 Venom 关卡地面不显示的问题。

summary: Nextendo online play, fixes for Ocarina of Time and Donkey Kong Bananza, and better frame pacing with frame generation.
summary_zh_CN: 支持通过 Nextendo 联机，修复《时之笛》和《咚奇刚 蕉力全开》的问题，并改善插帧开启时的帧间隔。

changes.title: Online play through Nextendo
changes.body: Turn on Nextendo in Configure → Network. Sign in separately for each user profile.
changes.body_zh_CN: 在「设置 → 网络」中启用 Nextendo。每个用户档案需要单独登录。

changes.title: Frame generation and online races
changes.body: Frame pacing now counts game frames rather than generated frames, fixing a cause of online race disconnects.
changes.body_zh_CN: 帧间隔现在按游戏原始帧计算，修复了插帧导致在线竞速断开连接的一种情况。

changes.title: IPv6 support
changes.body: Games can open IPv6 connections and look up IPv6 addresses. IPv4 behavior is unchanged.
changes.body_zh_CN: 游戏现在可以建立 IPv6 连接并查询 IPv6 地址，同时继续支持原有的 IPv4 连接。

changes.title: Ocarina of Time
changes.body: FPS Unlock works alongside code cheats and warns about conflicts. Castle Town no longer loses the Vulkan device on AMD at 1.5× or 2×.
changes.body_zh_CN: 帧率解锁补丁可与金手指同时使用，检测到冲突时会提示。修复 AMD 显卡在 1.5 倍或 2 倍分辨率下进入城堡镇时的 Vulkan 设备丢失问题。

changes.title: Donkey Kong Bananza
changes.body: The tutorial panel no longer appears black or flashes, and looping videos no longer stall.
changes.body_zh_CN: 修复教程面板发黑或闪烁，以及视频循环播放时卡住的问题。
